title: REACH: An RL-based Hierarchical Humanoid Crawling Framework for Adaptable Confined Space Traversal
abstract: arXiv:2610.36546v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid locomotion in confined spaces requires continuous height adaptation across multiple locomotion modes, yet most existing approaches remain limited to height-adjustable bipedal walking. We present REACH, an RL-based hierarchical framework that enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to traverse height-constrained environments through variable-height bipedal walking and crawling. The learned policies regulate body height over complementary command ranges of 1.27--0.50m in bipedal locomotion and 0.50--0.20m in crawling, extending traversal beyond the clearance limits of crouched walking. To address contact-rich crawling dynamics, we employ a history-conditioned latent representation that captures terrain and interaction context from proprioceptive observations. A bidirectional transition policy further connects crouched bipedal locomotion and crawling across large kinematic and contact discontinuities. These skills are integrated with a LiD

translated_title: REACH：一种基于强化学习的分层人形机器人爬行框架，用于自适应的受限空间穿越
translated_abstract: 人形机器人在受限空间中的运动需要在多种运动模式之间进行连续的高度自适应，然而现有大多数方法仍局限于可调节高度的双足行走。我们提出了REACH，一个基于强化学习的分层框架，使Unitree G1人形机器人能够通过可变高度双足行走和爬行来穿越高度受限的环境。学习到的策略在互补的指令范围内调节身体高度：双足行走为1.27至0.50米，爬行为0.50至0.20米，将可穿越范围扩展到蹲姿行走的净空限制之外。为了应对接触丰富的爬行动力学，我们采用了基于历史条件的潜在表示，从本体感觉观测中捕获地形和交互上下文信息。双向过渡策略进一步在大运动学和接触不连续性之间实现了蹲姿双足行走与爬行之间的切换。这些技能与激光雷达（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了REACH，一个基于强化学习的分层框架，使Unitree G1人形机器人能够通过可变高度双足行走（1.27–0.50米）与爬行（0.50–0.20米）以及双向模式切换策略，实现受限空间中的自适应穿越。
en_tdlr: REACH is an RL-based hierarchical framework enabling the Unitree G1 humanoid to traverse height-constrained spaces through variable-height bipedal walking and crawling, connected by a bidirectional transition policy.
